calls.title: Trade Me<>GrowthBook - POC Check In Call
calls.summary:
We need to summarize the call transcript in 2-3 sentences. Focus on: product/features/pain points, key participants and roles, next steps/action items.

From transcript:
- Product: GrowthBook experimentation platform, used for A/A test and future A/B test. Discussed AI experiment (map search count feature), holdout feature, time zone issue with Snowflake.
- Pain points: UTC time zone discrepancy between GrowthBook and Snowflake (NZ time). Need to set session to UTC as workaround. Holdout setup tricky due to UI and order of operations.
- Participants: Brian Wang (TradeMe?), Ruby J (TradeMe?), Logan Bates (GrowthBook), Kevin Dyer (TradeMe?) - roles: Brian seems lead/manager, Ruby is implementing, Logan is GrowthBook support, Kevin is technical (data engineer?).
- Next steps: Turn on A/A test tomorrow (Wednesday) with real users. Share data in channel by Friday. GrowthBook to review over weekend. By Monday decide on A/B test. Logan to research holdout issue and time zone fix, also confirm best practice for transitioning from A/A to A/B (reshuffling vs phases). Ruby and Kevin to try adding holdout as suggested. End of day update from Logan.

Summary: The call reviewed progress on the GrowthBook A/A test for TradeMe's AI experiment, focusing on data integration (time zone workaround) and holdout configuration. Key participants were Brian Wang
